title: Fantastic looking - descriptions are accurate.
text: Fantastic looking - descriptions are accurate.. Unit arrived on-time, the packaging was crushed on at least 2 sides. I was nervous, but there were firm corner supports and the unit was set back from the edges and undisturbed.  Installation was accompanied with an exterior support; just as a precautionary measure.  I chose to skip the side skirts and carved out an exact cut-out of the unit into 1/2" plywood; approx 12"x18".  I covered the plywood with white paneling and trimmed with matching corner round for a finished look.  The appearance is both stealth and rich.  The remote did not work. (I suspect battery).  The app worked great; so I use it exclusively for now.  It is somewhat louder than expected, but my wife enjoys the distraction, and this is in our sunroom - so it's not that big a deal.  The eco mode setting on restart is apparently Gov. required.  I'm not really interested in what the temp setting is; I just lowered until I was comfortable and use that as my baseline.  Overall, so far it's met our expectations.  Would have been higher rating if it was slightly quieter with a working remote, but the apps work just fine on ipad, iphone and Android devices especially the ability to program on and off settings, or remotely control the unit while away.

description: With the Frigidaire gallery 8, 000 BTU cool connect smart window air conditioner you can cool your room from anywhere, anytime using your smart device. Only run your AC when you need it so you can save on energy costs. The Frigidaire app provides you the convenience to remotely turn the unit on or off, change temperature, plus control modes and fan speeds. You will also stay informed with up-to-date alerts, such as clean filter indicators and other key notifications. With effortless Scheduling, conveniently develop a custom schedule for your AC 24 hours a day. Perfect for cooling a room up to 350 square feet you can easily program your AC day and night, during the week, and on weekends. Please note: product available for use only within the contiguous United States. The Frigidaire app is available on apple's itunes store and runs on the iphone, iPad, and iPad mini. For Android smart devices (smart phones and tablets) you can download the app at Google play.
